notes: Illustration: trouser three-quarter front with belt-looped waistband, a plain besom on the far hip, and the subject marked as a long steeply-slanted (about 12 degrees off vertical) opening running from the waistband down to roughly a third of the hip depth, ending in a bartack, positioned just inboard of the front crease. The candidate matches this closely — measured start point, angle (about 10 degrees) and length (about 30% of frame height, vs about 31% in the drawing) all track the drawing. Because the option's own label names a stripe, a real contrast material is correct here: it is rendered as a fine ecru piping along the opening edge, not as literal red, so the annotation-colour rule is respected. Besom, belt loops and crease all reproduced as drawn. Two minor composition findings only; geometry is clean.
